title: [3.0-beta1] Incorrect COB
body:
## Condition / Lead up
AAPS Version: v3.0-beta1 build 24a277bf1
Nightscout: 14.2.2
Pump: DanaRS (v3, Model: 05, Protocol: 11, Code: F0)
CGM: DexcomG6 (Patched App)

10/27/2021 08:35 - Food (35g) & Bolus 3.37U
10/27/2021 09:15 - Checked Overview & noticed 60g COB

Cross checked COB in Treatments & Loop. All showing as 60g.
Suspect that original 35g was somehow doubled, NS issue?

## Observations

No issues with CGM or Pump comms
